summary: 一小时左右做一个一次性可玩原型回答一个问题（通常是这个机制好不好玩）：一问简报、白盒、调试面板、试玩和留、砍、调的判断。 Builds a throwaway playable prototype in about an hour to answer one question, usually "is this mechanic fun?": a one-question brief, a greybox, a debug HUD, a playtest and a keep, kill or retune call. Use for "prototype this", "just get something playable" or whether to keep prototype code. Not for a timed jam (`game-jam`) or level blockouts (`level-design`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill prototype-fast，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for "prototype this", "just get something playable" or whether to keep prototype code.
Workflow: Write the brief first; Default to throwaway; Contain it; Greybox everything but the verb.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：game-jam 用 gene_gdsk_game_jam_v1，level-design 用 gene_gdsk_level_design_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
